Direction: # All frames are TV: [Tag][Value...][CRC8]. The Length byte was removed; each side derives the value size from the Tag (see eCvReqValueLen / eCvRspValueLen in cv_usart_task.c). CRC8 covers Tag+Value (DJI poly G(x)=x^8+x^5+x^4+1
Message: init 0xFF). Floats are 32-bit little-endian fp32. Send-delay is uint32 little-endian microseconds (request-received to just-before-UART-transmit).

Description: Requested info: 0x00=game progress 0x01=team color 0x02=robot type 0x03=robot HP
Status value: progress/color/type 0x00 or 0xFF; HP low byte
